examples.vi: Bố mẹ tôi luôn nghi ngờ những người lạ đề nghị giúp đỡ trên mạng.

examples.en: She gave him a suspicious look when he answered the phone.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nhìn anh với vẻ nghi ngờ khi anh trả lời điện thoại.

thesaurus.definition: openly distrustful and unwilling to confide
not as expected

vi_block: Đáng ngờ, khả nghi; ám muội, mập mờ (thái độ... ).
Đa nghi, hay nghi ngờ, hay ngờ vực.

examples: His suspicious behaviour brought him to the attention of the police.
wiktionary.gloss: Arousing suspicion.

examples: We know he has a suspicious attitude to get-rich-quick schemes.
wiktionary.gloss: Distrustful or tending to suspect.

examples: She gave me a suspicious look.
wiktionary.gloss: Expressing suspicion

tatoeba.vi: Nó trông cực kì đáng ngờ.

wiktionary.gloss: To invoke in an oath; to swear upon.

examples: I swear by my Petit Larousse when it comes to learning French.
He swears by cream of tartar to make the meringues stiff.
wiktionary.gloss: To trust wholeheartedly.

blocks.etymology: In reference to Tinder, a software program for computer dating; users accept or reject potential matches by respectively swiping right or left on a touchscreen.

wiktionary.gloss: To reject or discard something.

blocks.etymology: From thunder + cloud.

thesaurus.definition: a dark cloud of great vertical extent charged with electricity; associated with thunderstorms

wiktionary.gloss: A large, dark cloud, usually a cumulonimbus, charged with electricity and producing thunder and lightning.

examples: the ominous thunderclouds of war
wiktionary.gloss: Something menacing and brooding.

blocks.etymology: tongue + tip

wiktionary.gloss: The tip of the tongue.

blocks.etymology: From unforgettable + -ness.

wiktionary.gloss: The state or condition of being unforgettable; outstanding memorableness.
